social_circle.name: Emily Clark

background.how_they_met: She met Adam through mutual friends after he moved to South Florida for work.
background.why_close: They share a home, finances, routines, meals, planning, and major decisions. She is Adam's closest emotional support and helps him maintain boundaries around work.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in clear, warm full sentences with occasional dry humor. She sends reminders, grocery notes, calendar screenshots, and direct check-ins when Adam seems stressed.

recent_text_topics: Coordinating Sunday grocery plans so weeknights do not turn into takeout.
Checking whether Adam is stopping work on time, especially after Friday production issues or consulting deadlines.
Talking through future family plans and whether they want children.
Insurance renewals, hurricane supplies, appointments, and shared household expenses.
Light back-and-forth about Friday classic movie choices and dinner plans.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Adam is married and that his wife is 'the person I spend the most time with' and keeps him from getting too locked into work mode. Q11 says they live together and split responsibilities. Q44 says she calmly called out his stress reaction. Q83 says they share financial priorities.

social_circle.name: Sarah Clark

background.how_they_met: She is Adam's younger sister; they grew up together in the Milwaukee area in the same stable two-parent household.
background.why_close: They are steady family contacts who do not talk every day but check in by text, video call, and around holidays. Their bond is based on shared upbringing, family obligations, and mutual reliability.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Uses casual, friendly texts, often with quick updates, family photos, and mild teasing about Adam's spreadsheets and planning habits. She uses emojis more than Adam does.

shared_activities: Thanksgiving and Fourth of July coordination
recent_text_topics: Checking in about their parents' health, insurance paperwork, and appointments.
Coordinating possible holiday visits and whether Adam and Emily will travel north or host in Florida.
Joking about Adam over-planning travel and home projects.
Sharing small family updates, photos, and birthday reminders.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q05 says Adam has a sister he keeps in touch with 'mostly by text and occasional video calls.' Q06 says his parents and younger sister are the main immediate family and that he talks with his sister 'usually a couple times a month by text.' Q99 confirms he lived with his younger sister growing up.

social_circle.name: Linda Clark

background.how_they_met: She is Adam's mother and raised him in a practical middle-class household in the Milwaukee area.
background.why_close: She shaped Adam's planning habits and family orientation. They stay connected by phone, texts, visits, and holidays despite living in different states.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in complete sentences and often sends practical reminders, appointment updates, and family logistics. She is more likely to follow a text with a phone call if the topic feels important.

shared_activities: Cuban food outings when she visits
discussing family health and insurance paperwork
recent_text_topics: Helping her understand medical bills, insurance plan details, or appointment paperwork.
Planning a winter visit to Hollywood and deciding which beach or Cuban restaurant to revisit.
Family birthday reminders and holiday travel timing.
Checking whether Adam and Emily are doing okay with work stress and hurricane-season preparation.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q01 says Adam's mother worked as an office administrator and kept people connected. Q05 says his parents are important, they talk by phone, and visit around holidays. Q13 says his parents visit most often, usually in winter. Q35 and Q40 say Adam helps his parents with health and insurance paperwork.

social_circle.name: Mark Reynolds

background.how_they_met: He met Adam through the Hollywood Beach jogging club.
background.why_close: They bonded over early morning running, practical health habits, and being steady rather than flashy. Mark is one of the jogging friends Adam sees most often outside his household.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts short, useful messages: route ideas, weather notes, pace checks, and occasional jokes about knees and stretching. Uses a few emojis but mostly keeps it direct.

shared_activities: talking through running injuries and training volume
recent_text_topics: Coordinating early runs before the beach gets crowded or the summer heat builds.
Checking whether Adam's knee irritation is improving and suggesting mobility work.
Deciding whether weekend weather is better for running or cycling.
Light jokes about Adam's watch data and how he cannot pretend five hours of sleep is fine.
social_circle.evidence_from_interview: Q07 says some of Adam's close friends are from the Hollywood Beach jogging club, and when asked who he sees most often outside the household, he says 'probably two friends from the jogging group.' Q10 and Q15 describe early beach runs. Q33 mentions knee irritation and physical therapy exercises.

background.why_close: They trust each other's judgment, talk candidly about work stress, and share a preference for sustainable engineering practices over chaos.

personality_mini_profile.communication_style: Texts in crisp sentences with a dry, analytical tone. She sends links, screenshots, and practical advice, but keeps personal messages separate from company Slack.

shared_activities: discussing tech podcasts and professional learning
occasional board game nights with mutual friends
recent_text_topics: Adam's increased mentoring load and how to avoid taking responsibility for everyone's blockers.
AWS certification study resources and cloud architecture articles.
Whether a production incident could have been avoided with better testing and release process.
Coordinating lunch or coffee on office days.
Occasional measured discussion of local politics, misinformation, and cybersecurity.
